charts.title: Fed, ECB and BOJ harmonized policy rates
charts.rationale: Daily BIS harmonized rates on a common axis; compare level and tightening cycles.
charts.caveats: BIS can splice instruments; rate corridor midpoints are not Fed upper bound.

charts.title: Global real GDP growth
charts.rationale: Compare annual constant-price real GDP growth across countries and the world.
charts.caveats: Country composition and revised annual data; avoid projecting onto daily dates.

charts.title: Domestic listed-capitalization to GDP
charts.rationale: Compare listed equity capitalization relative to domestic output.
charts.caveats: Neither series is a perfect Buffett indicator; gaps and listing residence affect ratios.

charts.title: BIS credit-to-GDP gaps — United States, euro area and Japan
charts.rationale: Compare credit booms and deleveraging using the same BIS one-sided HP methodology across geographies.
charts.caveats: Percentage-point gap of private nonfinancial-sector credit to GDP; cross-country comparability depends on statistical definitions and coverage; not a world gap.

charts.title: Monthly gold / MSCI ACWI net-return correlation
charts.rationale: Trace variation in the trailing historical 36-month gold-global-equity return relationship using an actual NETR benchmark.
charts.caveats: World Bank gold monthly mean and monthly mean MSCI ACWI NETR USD index levels; Pearson on consecutive monthly arithmetic returns. Different from the existing GLD/VT ETF proxy.

charts.title: GDP-weighted international private-credit cycle (43 BIS economies)
charts.rationale: Compare country credit-to-GDP deviations using prior-year nominal GDP weights to reflect global credit-cycle exposure.
charts.caveats: Derived GDP-weighted average of national BIS one-sided HP-filter gaps; not an official world/BIS aggregate. Up to 43 economies; threshold >=80% of world GDP; use companion coverage chart.

charts.title: GDP coverage of the international private-credit composite
charts.rationale: Expose quarterly world GDP share represented by economies contributing to the GDP-weighted credit gap.
charts.caveats: Prior calendar-year USD GDP denominator; 80% inclusion threshold. Covered economies and weights vary over time; values below threshold omitted.

charts.title: World listed-company market capitalization relative to world GDP
charts.rationale: Track worldwide listed domestic equity market size relative to nominal global economic output since WDI WFE source history begins.
charts.caveats: Uses WDI WLD listed-market-capitalization / WDI WLD GDP; capital-market country coverage is incomplete and changes through time. Not the WDI country-weighted aggregate CM.MKT.LCAP.GD.ZS.

charts.title: World listed-company capitalization in current US dollars
charts.rationale: Show WFE-sourced WDI world aggregate listed domestic equity capitalization in annual nominal USD.
charts.caveats: USD values and geographic coverage vary; not inflation-adjusted and not the full worldwide listed corporate earnings numerator.

charts.title: Global equities aggregate trailing P/E (Siblis)
charts.rationale: Follow the normalized aggregate index price-to-earnings multiple on officially published month-end snapshots.
charts.caveats: Sparse selected dates rather than a complete historical monthly series; Siblis index covers ~3,000 companies and is not all worldwide listed issuers. Proprietary source; no public redistribution without rights.

charts.title: Global equities normalized trailing earnings yield
charts.rationale: Measure the inverse of the globally published Siblis index P/E as earnings relative to that index's capitalization.
charts.caveats: Not corporate net profits as a share of global GDP. Sparse year-end snapshots and distinct index universe; proprietary data require separate publishing permission.

charts.title: MSCI ACWI concentration — documented top-ten index weights
charts.rationale: Show actual MSCI ACWI top-ten constituent-weight trends using only date-stamped public index evidence, without any ETF holdings substitution.
charts.caveats: Sparse, nonuniformly spaced dated factsheet/research observations in monthly coordinates, NOT a continuous monthly history. Missing years/months are real gaps. Source provenance and exact report dates in data/msci_acwi_published_snapshots.json; rights review required.

charts.title: EU27 corporate gross operating surplus as share of GDP
charts.rationale: Track financial and non-financial corporation gross operating surplus relative to the entire EU economy, using matched official Eurostat annual ESA2010 sector accounts and GDP.
charts.caveats: EU27 only: includes unlisted corporations and excludes the rest of the world. Gross before fixed-capital consumption, not listed-company net profits or global GDP. Sector S11+S12 numerator against S1 GDP, both nominal million EUR.

charts.title: EU27 non-financial corporations: gross operating-surplus share of value added
charts.rationale: Official Eurostat macro indicator of how much nonfinancial corporate value added accrues as gross operating surplus instead of employee pay, taxes and subsidies.
charts.caveats: This official gross-profit-share denominator is NFC sector GVA, NOT GDP. Excludes financial corporations and households. Separate from the S11+S12/whole GDP series.

charts.title: OECD members: GDP-weighted corporate operating surplus / GDP
charts.rationale: Track corporate gross operating surplus as a share of national GDP across 2026's 38 OECD members, GDP weighted, without listing individual firms.
charts.caveats: OECD membership fixed retrospectively to 2026; GDP-weighted average is a documented researcher composite rather than an official aggregate published by OECD. Data only for years with at least 35/38 GDP weights, 29 country reports and >=80% GDP coverage. Two corporate sectors S11+S12, includes unlisted corporations, no households; WDI nominal USD GDP weighting, OECD country-local-account denominator. The US, Japan and Canada use currency-validated World Bank local nominal GDP when OECD product taxes are absent; all corporate numerators remain official OECD national accounts.

charts.title: OECD corporate-surplus data coverage — member GDP share
charts.rationale: Display how much of 38 member OECD GDP has complete numerator and denominator accounting data each year.
charts.caveats: Denominator comprises OECD members with available World Bank GDP USD and >=35/38 countries must have GDP weights; does not represent world GDP and may omit country GDP not published by WDI.

charts.title: OECD corporate-surplus data coverage — participating member countries
charts.rationale: Show the number of countries entering the GDP-weighted corporate surplus series at each annual observation.
charts.caveats: Count is of 2026's 38 current OECD member countries with complete annual matched OECD sector-account observations and GDP weights, not number of OECD members in the historical year. Excluded years are blank.

charts.title: World labour income share
charts.rationale: Income share of labour, measured as a level (% of output).
charts.caveats: Do not compare on the same axis with productivity growth rates.

charts.title: World labour productivity growth
charts.rationale: Annual rate of change in world labour productivity.
charts.caveats: Annual percentage growth rate, distinct from labour share of income.

charts.title: Monthly gold average, USD per troy ounce
charts.rationale: World Bank monthly nominal average gold prices.
charts.caveats: Monthly average prices are not daily gold spot or total returns.

charts.title: Worldwide public debt
charts.rationale: World aggregate of public debt as reported by the source.
charts.caveats: This is an annual/periodic debt measure, not a policy rate.
